policies.label: Advance electronic approval; border formalities follow
policies.n: Scope: this origin government’s ordinary passports. Obtain ANRPTS electronic approval before departure and carry the approval for air boarding. Border biometric and entry-finalisation formalities follow approval; the advance boarding document is distinct from final border processing and is not a separate walk-up arrival-visa alternative. The boarding statement is air-scoped and does not independently establish land/sea procedures. No single tourist stay is established; follow the permission granted.

Chinese private passports expressly require advance electronic visas from 5 January 2025. The July 2026 guide requires an invitation letter and links February/March company-invitation requirements: a legally operating Mauritanian company, tax/registration and business details, invitee details, purpose and itinerary. Do not assume employment or a qualifying invitation; individual tourist invitation eligibility must be confirmed.

policies.label: Visa required; approved southern-tour arrival branch
policies.n: Italian ordinary passports require a visa; consular issue is described. A conditional arrival branch exists for an authorized organized journey through a recognized Algerian agency including at least one Saharan tourist site. The agency must preregister travel-document details; the stated airports are Algiers and, currently among southern airports, Djanet. This is not unrestricted walk-up issuance. No permitted stay is established; visa expiry and authorized duration both apply.

policies.label: Ordinary-passport visa exemption; stay unspecified

policies.label: Ordinary-passport tourism exemption
policies.n: Korean MFA’s September 2026 outbound table explicitly gives ordinary Korean passports a 90-day visa exemption for tourism/visits. Diplomatic and official entries are separate.

policies.label: Visa required unless qualifying document exemption
policies.n: A visa is required for ordinary Chinese-passport visitors without a qualifying exemption; the Chinese Embassy’s April 2026 notice addresses actual Chinese-passport arrivals. Method and visa-based stay remain unestablished. A separate conditional 30-day exemption is described for a valid visa from Canada, USA, Australia, Republic of Korea, Japan, UK, Singapore or an EU member. Decree Article1 also covers qualifying residence from these jurisdictions; the mission’s practical checklist expressly confirms US permanent-resident cards. The October 2024 amendment replaces the older prior-use/six-month-validity clause. Passport validity of at least three months, return ticket and at least USD500 solvency are required for that branch. No third-country visa/residence or Panamanian local status is assumed.
